sample.include: USD-target stablecoins in the frozen 41-asset pilot universe
sample.h7_primary_supply_share_sample: all 14 USD-target primary stablecoins passing the preregistered coverage gate
sample.h7_exploratory_usage_rationale: Coin Metrics Community provides common daily active-address, ledger-transaction, and token-transfer histories for these four assets; the subsample is source-defined before usage estimation
sample.h7_usage_scope_rule: usage coefficients are exploratory and are not required for the 14-asset primary supply/share specification

peg_measurement.daily_episode_onset: first daily observation strictly outside primary breach band
peg_measurement.daily_episode_recovery: first later daily observation at or inside recovery band
peg_measurement.intraday_rule: future five-minute panel requires three consecutive observations outside 50 bps after one hour inside 25 bps; recovery requires twelve consecutive observations inside 25 bps

H5.claim: Higher reserve quality reduces peg error, breach probability, severity, and recovery time

H6.claim: Greater redemption friction increases peg error, breach probability, severity, and recovery time, especially under stress

H7.claim: Liquidity, integrations, usage, and supply growth explain stablecoin adoption and market share
H7.expected_sign: positive for adoption; liquidity expected negative for peg error

outcomes.global_market_share_status: global_peggedusd_supply_share uses the exact-date DeFiLlama totalCirculatingUSD.peggedUSD denominator; pilot_observed_supply_share remains a within-pilot measure

covariates.distribution_proxy_caveat: chain distribution is not protocol integration count or transaction usage
covariates.trading_activity_caveat: reported 24-hour volume is not spread, depth, price impact, or executable liquidity and is available only for the recent free window
covariates.usage_caveat: Coin Metrics coverage is restricted to USDT, USDC, DAI, and TUSD; active addresses are not unique users; results are exploratory and cannot be generalized to the full 14-asset sample
covariates.required_lag_rule: time-varying explanatory variables use information available by t-1 unless explicitly contemporaneous in a descriptive specification
covariates.design_effective_date_rule: scores apply only on or after their evidence/effective date; no backward propagation

models.continuous_peg_error: asset and calendar-time fixed-effects panel model; standard errors clustered by asset and date where supported
models.breach_probability: linear probability primary; rare-event logit robustness
models.episode_recovery: Cox proportional hazards primary; accelerated failure-time robustness
models.adoption: asset and time fixed-effects panel on log supply, market share, and growth for the 14-asset coverage-qualified sample
models.usage_exploratory: separate four-asset lagged panel for USDT, USDC, DAI, and TUSD; report as exploratory and do not replace the primary 14-asset adoption specification

stress_definition.primary: predeclared external event windows from a dated event registry completed before headline estimation
stress_definition.data_driven_robustness: months in the top decile of leave-one-asset-out marketwide 50-bps breach intensity

missing_data.unknown_design_scores: excluded from design-score regressions and counted in a completeness table
missing_data.missing_price_day: no observation; open episode right-censored at preceding date
missing_data.missing_supply: retain peg outcome row with supply fields null
missing_data.partial_scores: diagnostic only; prohibited from headline models

outliers.primary: no winsorization of verified peg outcomes
outliers.unverified_source_anomaly: withhold only under documented review flag set before model estimation

H5: point-in-time reserve scores for at least 8 primary assets
at least two score dates per asset where time variation is claimed
H6: strict redemption-friction scores for at least 8 primary assets
H7: four-asset usage subsample fixed before estimation and labeled exploratory
